choices.reason: No rule selects a unique candidate: the available paper names no primary outcome or contrast, and its abstract and introduction present flexibility, fluency, and originality across all three partner conditions together. Rule 3 cannot rank different outcomes or controls; all candidates also concern the same assisted session, the same AI arm, and comparisons of entire arms, so rules 4-6 do not break the tie.

choices.quote: The results showed that the human–ChatGPT group generated the most flexible and fluent solutions, while the human–human group produced the most original solutions in solving mathematical creativity tasks.
